item.title: [NVDA Bullish (+0.24), AMZN Neutral (+0.13)] Report: Amazon to offload $8B worth of AI chips, lease them back
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Bullish (+0.24), AMZN Neutral (+0.13)
Amazon.com Inc. is reportedly planning a financial maneuver to offload approximately $8 billion worth of AI chips, specifically Grace Blackwell accelerators, into a special purpose vehicle (SPV) and then lease them back. This strategy, similar to those employed by other tech giants, aims to remove the assets and associated debt from Amazon's balance sheet, thereby improving its debt-to-equity ratio and credit rating. The SPV will issue debt and a 10% equity stake to external investors to finance the deal, which involves between 114,000 and 133,000 chips installed in five Amazon data centers.
